places.name: Istanbul
places.clue: Once Byzantium and Constantinople, it straddles the Bosphorus between Europe and Asia.

places.name: Ankara
places.clue: Turkey's capital since 1923 and home to Anıtkabir, Atatürk's mausoleum.

places.name: Cappadocia (Göreme)
places.clue: Fairy-chimney rock spires, cave churches and dawn hot-air balloon flights.

places.name: Pamukkale
places.clue: The "cotton castle": white travertine terraces topped by the Roman spa city of Hierapolis.

places.name: Ephesus
places.clue: A great Greco-Roman city with the Library of Celsus and the site of the Temple of Artemis.

places.name: Troy
places.clue: The mound of Hisarlık, setting of Homer's Iliad, holds nine layers of ancient cities.

places.name: Antalya
places.clue: A Mediterranean resort city with a walled old town and Hadrian's Gate.

places.name: Mount Nemrut
places.clue: Giant stone heads guard the hilltop tomb-sanctuary of King Antiochus I of Commagene.

places.name: Mount Ararat
places.clue: Turkey's highest peak, a dormant volcano linked in tradition to Noah's Ark.

places.name: Göbekli Tepe
places.clue: Carved stone pillars over 11,000 years old, built by hunter-gatherers.

places.name: Hattusa
places.clue: Capital of the Hittite Empire, entered through the famous Lion Gate.

places.name: Sumela Monastery
places.clue: A Greek Orthodox monastery clinging to a sheer cliff face above a forested valley near Trabzon.
